verdict.rationale: Pricing model is a fair question for a support platform with AI agents, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers Pylon's pricing, per-resolution billing, published rates, or spending caps and controls. Agent assignment controls (pylon-docs-18) govern which issues the agent touches, not cost, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a support leader, pricing is outcome-based and published — I pay per resolution with caps and controls, not an opaque enterprise quote
